# Paisley Pastel

Paisley Pastel is a quiet G4 background earth mare with a pale yellow-cream coat, muted blue mane and tail, turquoise eyes and three pink-and-blue paisley motifs for a cutie mark. Think of her as the blue-haired mare at the train station and in several historical flashbacks. [Character catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_ponies/Earth_ponies/Mares) · [Cutie mark catalog](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/List_of_cutie_marks).

[![Paisley Pastel in One Bad Apple — Friendship is Magic, Hasbro Studios; fan-posted screenshot](https://preview.redd.it/who-is-this-pony-v0-9md5159xudxb1.jpg?auto=webp&s=c49800089cedfd4eb632b527d1a609c6566a0c39)](https://www.reddit.com/r/mylittlepony/comments/17k02c1/who_is_this_pony/)

*Name and voice:* Her design appears in the official television continuity, but Paisley Pastel is a fandom name: a [February 7, 2013 wiki discussion](https://mlp.fandom.com/wiki/Forum%3ANewly-winning_placeholder_names) records its adoption following a naming poll. The screenshot discussion above also suggests Jolene as an alternate fan name, but that tag could not be independently verified. No individual spoken lines, voice actor, official name, or film/comic role were verified.

*Other appearances:* The character catalog also identifies her model in [Appleoosa's Most Wanted (S5E6)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/appleoosas-most-wanted/umc.cmc.563l8a8nsbtf4axuyat2pclg4) with a design variation and [No Second Prances (S6E6)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/no-second-prances/umc.cmc.tmzpr9mfnhkbbtp0vosc4hze), both in flashbacks. Reused models do not establish a single continuous biography.

*Fandom:* In the fan-fiction continuity of [Do Changelings Dream of Twinkling Stars? — The Old Flame](https://www.fimfiction.net/story/193262/2/do-changelings-dream-of-twinkling-stars/2-the-old-flame), she is reinvented as an interspecies-rights activist and the narrator's former lover; this is not her television backstory.

## Important moments

No character-defining dialogue or decisions were verified. These are her most recognizable documented scenes instead:

- *Early Ponyville* — [Family Appreciation Day (S2E12)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/family-appreciation-day/umc.cmc.okjcrx8q5c7ypzqhc95tot0m): her design appears in Granny Smith's sepia recollection of Ponyville's history. Timestamp unavailable.
- *The Manehattan train* — [One Bad Apple (S3E4)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/one-bad-apple/umc.cmc.3jzfq6mv0rb8rhvh7yfbs0637): she steps off the Friendship Express at Ponyville, offering a recognizable present-day appearance. Timestamp unavailable.
- *Another memory* — [Leap of Faith (S4E20)](https://tv.apple.com/us/episode/leap-of-faith/umc.cmc.5zzt381cbm8ywh4t5ef9h0sv9): her model reappears in Granny Smith's recollections of her youth. Timestamp unavailable.

*Research limits:* The wiki entries were available through indexed excerpts, but direct access was blocked. The screenshot post and its image link were located, though the asset could not be independently rendered. No attributable fan illustration or scene timestamp could be verified, so none was invented.
